trailhead.label: Val Pelouse car park at the end of the D 208, the board’s start

cautions: Working alpages: sheep or cows may graze around the refuge and the col in summer, possibly with guard dogs; keep your dog on a lead and walk round the herds.
Open crest at about 1,720–2,000 m: little shade and quick weather changes.
The descent follows a grassy ski slope that is steep in places.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
